facts.text: Caroline attended an LGBTQ support group on the previous day and found it to be a powerful experience.

evidence.quote: I went to a LGBTQ support group yesterday and it was so powerful.
What happened that was so awesome?

facts.text: Caroline expressed feeling accepted and courageous as a result of the support group.

evidence.quote: The support group has made me feel accepted and given me courage to embrace myself.

facts.text: Caroline mentioned that the transgender stories shared in the support group were inspiring.

evidence.quote: The transgender stories were so inspiring!
